day.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
day.readme: Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. snapshot returns the page as compact text with a ref such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call.

day.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
day.readme: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. This is the skill that seeded Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, described in Build your own vulnerability harness. The harness grew into a multi-stage, fleet-wide system; this skill is the single-repo starting point it evolved from.

day.description: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
day.readme: This repository contains Agent Skills for Google products and technologies, including Google Cloud. When prompted, select specific skills or all skills, the target agents to configure, and the installation scope (project or global). If npx is not available in your environment, install Node.js, which includes npm and npx. To update previously installed skills to the latest versions, run the following This command gives you an option to also remove obsolete skills.

day.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
day.readme: My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding. Developing real applications is hard. Approaches like GSD, BMAD, and Spec-Kit try to help by owning the process. But while doing so, they take away your control and make bugs in the process hard to resolve. These skills are designed to be small, easy to adapt, and composable. They work with any model. They're based on decades of engineering experience. Hack around with them. Make them your own. Enjoy.

Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks.

day.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
day.readme: An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them. Currently in Beta · Built on React 19+ and StyleX Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company, powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day.

day.description: The Prometheus monitoring system and time series database.
day.readme: Visit prometheus.io for the full documentation, Prometheus, a Cloud Native Computing Foundation project, is a systems and service monitoring system. It collects metrics from configured targets at given intervals, evaluates rule expressions, displays the results, and can trigger alerts when specified conditions are observed.

day.readme: A utility-first CSS framework for rapidly building custom user interfaces. For full documentation, visit tailwindcss.com. day.description: Control your Samsung appliances from Home Assistant over your home network, with no cloud account.
day.readme: Control your Samsung appliances from Home Assistant over your home network, with no cloud account. LocalThings connects Home Assistant to Samsung washers, dryers, refrigerators, air conditioners, ovens and other appliances that work with the SmartThings app. It talks to each appliance on your local network. Updates are fast. Appliances that support push send changes as they happen. LocalThings checks the rest every 30 seconds. It works without the internet.

day.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
day.readme: Welcome to Zed, a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter. On macOS, Linux, and Windows you can download Zed directly or install Zed via your local package manager (macOS/Linux/Windows). Other platforms are not yet available: See CONTRIBUTING.md for ways you can contribute to Zed. Also... we're hiring! Check out our jobs page for open roles. day.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) ,small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (5x fewer tokens) .上下文压缩插件，月级长会话会话， 兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token) . billion-context is all you need
day.readme: Context-compression plugin, billion-context is all you need. npm install -g billion-context --prefix=~/.local Model-Driven Incremental Hierarchical Compression: Training-Free Multi-Generational Context Management for Long-Lived Coding Agents (English, v0.2) A production-scale longitudinal study: 4.5 months, three hosts, 174,327 model calls, 18.76B cumulative input tokens (~24.7B across all hosts), zero window violations on 204,800-token models, marathon sessions of 8,584–12,049 calls.

day.description: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.
day.readme: Run a managed Kubernetes service on your own NVIDIA GPU infrastructure. NVIDIA Kubernetes® Engine (NVKE) provides the management plane that platform teams install to create and operate Kubernetes clusters for their customers. Each workload cluster has its own Kubernetes control plane, etcd and node pools. You operate the NVKE management plane; your customers use their clusters through the Kubernetes API and kubectl.

week.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
week.readme: Your coding agent forgets everything between sessions. Claude-Mem remembers for it. Every new session, your agent starts from zero. It re-reads the same files, re-asks the same questions, and walks back into mistakes you already fixed together. Claude-Mem runs a second agent beside it that takes notes while it works. The next session starts with a short index of what matters, and pulls in the details only when it needs them. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and 11 more agents.

week.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
week.readme: Worktrunk is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel. Worktrunk's three core commands make worktrees as easy as branches. Plus, Worktrunk has a bunch of quality-of-life features to simplify working with many parallel changes, including hooks to automate local workflows & copy-on-write build caches. AI agents like Claude Code and Codex can handle longer tasks without supervision, such that it's possible to manage 5-10+ in parallel.

week.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio, 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
week.readme: Turn a single Claude Code session into a full game development studio. 49 agents. 74 skills. One coordinated AI team. Building a game solo with AI is powerful, but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code. There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?" Claude Code Game Studios solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio.

week.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎, 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
week.readme: 一、项目理念：紫微斗数是中国传统命理学的瑰宝，倪海厦老师在《天纪》中系统梳理了正宗的紫微斗数体系。我们希望通过技术手段让更多人接触和学习这门学问。 开源排盘算法和知识库，是因为我们相信：算法是公开的传统智慧，不应该被锁在围墙里。真正的价值在于解读的深度、用户体验的打磨、以及持续运营的积累。 二、项目信息：基于 倪海厦《天纪》 教学体系的紫微斗数排盘系统，包含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据，以及一套完整开源的紫微斗数解读数据：v4.0 解读数据集, , 67.5 万张命盘 × 13 维 = 877 万段解读，正文约 204 亿字，解压后 56.6 GB（2026-10-15 发布）。 v3.0 每张盘解读字数按 2,160 张盘抽样估算，其余数字为全量统计；两版每张盘都是 13 维。 在线体验：ouranic.cn，排盘、AI 解读、命盘历史全部开放。 本轮跟随网站 2026-10-15 发版（网站内容版本 ca268829f7a9）： 1.

Spec Kit is an open source toolkit that gives AI coding agents structured processes, reusable templates, and documented outcomes. Start with a ready-made process, customize it, or bring your own. SDD ships in core; bug fixing and assessment are bundled extensions you install when needed, and the primitives below let you adopt or create other processes.

week.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
week.readme: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them. It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it doesn't just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do.

new.description: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
new.readme: dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness. It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person. It is also a way of working with an agent: take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.

new.description: VERY experimental Nintendo Switch 2 emulator
new.readme: Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. Visit the official Lichii website to find games and compare community compatibility reports. Download Lichii only from this repository's releases page.

new.description: A research prototype for zero-knowledge proofs of AI inference. Not maintained.
new.readme: FlashProve lets an AI provider prove which model answered a request, without revealing the model's Commit. The provider publishes a commitment ID, which binds it to one set of weights. The weights themselves stay secret: every published value that depends on them is masked, except a declared list. Prove. For each reply, the provider's GPU produces a proof that the reply is the committed Verify.

new.description: Emulate macOS on iOS and iPadOS
new.readme: Download macOS, install it on the device, and use it. Own emulator, iOS gives apps no hypervisor, so Henge runs the Mac's arm64 code through its own JIT, with its own MMU and devices. It doesn't use QEMU or Virtualization.framework. Installs on the device, Henge downloads Apple's restore image and restores it the way a Mac does. No Mac needed, and nothing is decrypted or patched. Graphics, macOS draws through a virtual GPU, and Henge replays its commands with Metal.

gap.method: Lag is how long before the open model's release a closed model first reached the same Capabilities Index score. Today's figure measures from that closed model to today, so it grows until an open model moves the frontier.
